findings.description: The new `min` parameter defaults to 1, which changes behavior for existing callers. Before this change the wait could be below 1 second, because the floor was 0.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `wait_exponential_jitter(initial=0.1, jitter=0)` or any configuration that previously produced waits under 1s. Mechanism: line 273 applies `max(max(0, self.min), ...)`, so with the default `min=1` every wait is clamped up to at least 1s. Impact: users who configured sub-second backoff silently get slower retries. A default of 0 would preserve the old behavior.
